question: Does Strata v0.2.10 (engine 0.1.56) improve tok/s vs the live v0.1.44 install?
method: Same protocol as the 2026-10-14 A/B: prebuilt rx9070 (gfx1201) engine from the v0.2.10 release, installed in /root/strata-0210, served on :8081 with the IDENTICAL arg set as live (IQ3_S GSQ-RCO, spec 4, spec-min-p 0.5, MTP, k8v4, 262144 ctx, ple-io ram, shared-expert-arena, adapt-async 1, same hipBLASLt tuning table). Live v0.1.44 server stopped during measurement (host cannot hold both). Warmup + 5x 256-token decode medians (gen_probe.py, unique nonce text) + 46.8K-token cold prefill.

chunk32k (STRATA_PREFILL_AUTO_MAX=32768).verdict: no reliable gain (Oct finding on v0.1.44 also null) - leave prefill auto

concurrency_4_streams.server_batch_stat: 48.5 rows/s, avg 3.39 rows/window, 34.33 ms/window; routed experts: 84% VRAM hits / 16% CPU

notes: 0.2.10 changelog (3474 commits) is dominated by the multi-card split engine (strata-split-N-amd), DeepSeek vision, Mac Metal paths - single-GPU gfx1201 gains come from gfx12 WMMA/quality-path work (e.g. 1f8ca8de RDNA4 routed-expert/draft/shared-expert/head kernels, hyper-connection Q8_0 read at load, amd queue ordering 3f1fa67f).
Engine logs show a NEW default on gfx12: hyper-connection projections read as Q8_0 (STRATA_HC_Q8=0 reverts to bf16); answers differ slightly, decode faster.
strata-split-2/3/4-amd binaries ship in the tarball; split is auto only for UD-Q4 expert family on 4x cards - IQ3_S single-card unaffected.

Install layout: /root/strata (git checkout, v0.1.44 engine at /root/strata-v0144) still live config at :8080; /root/strata-0210 holds the prebuilt 0.2.10 engine + its own config at :8081. Old install untouched as requested.
recommendation: Keep spec 4, spec-min-p 0.5, prefill auto (all swept alternatives regressed or tied). v0.2.10 is a straight win: +9% decode, +19% prefill at identical settings. Candidate follow-up: STRATA_HC_Q8=0 A/B if answer-parity with 0.1.44 matters.
